chunks: Hadith 2973 — A man said to al-Sadiq عليه السلام: “May I be your ransom, I had intended to include my mother or some of my family in my Hajj this year, but I forgot.”
So he عليه السلام said: “Now, then include them both.”

key_terms.أُشْرِكَ: to include or associate someone in the reward or devotional act
key_terms.حَجَّتِي: my Hajj; the pilgrimage being performed

ai.seo_question: Can someone include their mother or family in the reward of Hajj after forgetting to do so earlier?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that if a person intended to share the reward or participation of his Hajj with his mother or some family members but forgot, he may still do so afterward. It reflects the permissibility of including relatives in the devotional benefit of Hajj and shows consideration for family ties within acts of worship.
